Upscaler runtimes shipped next to pt (Linux build)

The full licence texts are the other files in this folder. What each one lets the port ship:

NVIDIA DLSS SDK 310.9.1 (libnvidia-ngx-dlss.so.310.9.1: DLSS Super Resolution;
libnvidia-ngx-dlssd.so.310.9.1: DLSS Ray Reconstruction, the denoiser of the Path traced ray
quality; libnvsdk_ngx.a, linked into pt)
  NVIDIA RTX SDKs licence (NVIDIA_RTX_SDKs_LICENSE.txt): the SDK's binaries may be
  distributed in object code inside an application with material additional functionality,
  only for systems with NVIDIA GPUs, under terms at least as protective as NVIDIA's. The
  files are the SDK's lib/Linux_x86_64/rel builds, unmodified. NGX itself
  (libnvidia-ngx.so.1) is part of the NVIDIA driver and is not shipped.

AMD FidelityFX SDK v1.1.4 (libamd_fidelityfx_vk.so: FSR 3.1 upscaler)
  MIT licence (AMD_FidelityFX_SDK_LICENSE.txt). AMD ships the FidelityFX API as Windows
  DLLs only; this library is built by the port from AMD's unmodified v1.1.4 sources (the
  FidelityFX API, the FSR 3.1.4 upscaler and the Vulkan backend) with a small Linux
  compatibility layer. It is not an AMD binary. FSR 3 frame generation is not included.

Intel XeSS: not shipped. The XeSS SDK has Windows libraries only.

NVIDIA, GeForce RTX and DLSS are trademarks of NVIDIA Corporation; AMD and FidelityFX are
trademarks of Advanced Micro Devices. P.T. port is not endorsed by NVIDIA or AMD.
